title: Today-only deal: Save $20 on this 100W Anker powerhouse charger
content:
Macworld

Anker 3-port charger

View Deal

If you’re tired of hauling three separate bricks just to keep your laptop, phone, and earbuds alive, this deal makes life a lot simpler. This awesome 3-port Anker charger is on sale today only for $20 off, which means you’re only paying $50 for it.

The fantastic part about this charger is that you can use it for just about everything you need at once since it has three ports. Since it can ramp up to 100W of power across all ports, you can use this charger with a laptop, phone, and your earbuds all at once. If that’s not convenient, I don’t know what is.

Other than the speeds, the coolest feature is that it comes with a built-in smart display on the front, something you won’t find in most chargers. That’s where you’ll get info about the total charging power delivered on each port, which is quite useful. The two USB-C ports can deliver up to 100W of power when used on their own, while the USB-A caps at 33W. When all ports are in use at the same time, the top C-port will cap at 80W, while the second one can hit 12W and the A-port 7.5W. Since the charger comes with smart power sensing, the numbers can change depending on the needs of each device you’re plugging in.

This charger will be a fantastic addition to any setup, and it will even be a great one to take with you when traveling because it’s quite small, measuring just 2.72 x 2.17 x 1.34 inches and featuring a foldable plug that won’t snag on anything.

For $50, this is an easy pick if you want an easy way to charge multiple devices simultaneously. Hurry up because this deal is only available today at Amazon.
